relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 was revealed to play an important role in pain transduction in pulpits, induce inflammation, and be involved in bone resorption during periodontitis.

relationships.subject: bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: such as pro-inflammatory cytokines, prostaglandins, glutamate, extracellular ATP, and bradykinin, can trigger TRPs, either directly or indirectly

key_findings: TRPV1 and TRPA1 mediate oral and trigeminal pain; TRPV1 also contributes to inflammation and bone resorption in periodontitis.
Inflammatory mediators including bradykinin and prostaglandins trigger TRP channels in pulpitis and periodontitis.
